items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps skin comfortable while it is still sensitive after your recent medication.
A ceramide moisturizer supports the skin barrier and helps with the moisture score without adding actives.
A mineral SPF 50 protects against sun, which can make the look of marks more noticeable.

response.routine_note: We have left out the 30% peel and other exfoliating or strong products, because skin that recently finished isotretinoin is best checked by a dermatologist or your prescriber before any peel, so please ask them about your marks and when a peel might be suitable. Meanwhile, cleanse and moisturize morning and night, and apply the SPF every morning.
